content: Womu ɡe Asɑfu u kuɑ. Ge wee.

content.text: Gusunɔ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ sun yinɑ.
Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ kɑ sun mɔru mɔ̀
bɛsɛ be ɑ kpɑre nɡe yɑ̃ɑ ɡɔ̃ɔ.
A bɛsɛ wunɛn tɔmbu yɑɑyo,
bɛsɛ be ɑ yɑkiɑ sɑɑ yellun di.
A bɛsɛn bwese kɛri yɑɑyo
yi yi kuɑ wunɛɡii.
A Siɔnin ɡuu te yɑɑyo
tèn mi wunɛn wɑ̃ɑ yerɑ rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
A doo ɑ wɑ nɡe mɛ yɑm mi, n bɑnsu kuɑ mɑm mɑm.
Yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu kpuro sɑnkɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee te sɔɔ.
Wunɛn yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ kukurɑ sɑ̃ɑ yeru mi nɡe ɡbee sinɑnsu
mɑ bɑ ben ɡidi bɔrɑ ɡirɑ mi.
Bɑ sɑ̃ɑre nɡe dɑ̃ɑ buro be bɑ ɡbɑ̃ɑ yiiyɑmɔ dɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔwɔ.
Mɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten burɑ yɑ̃nu kpuro kɔsukɑ kɑ ɡbɛ̃ɛ kɑ mɑtɑlɑkɑ.
Bɑ wunɛn sɑ̃ɑ yee te dɔ̃ɔ mɛni.
Bɑ tu disi doke te, te tɑ wunɛn yĩsiru sɔɔwɑ.
Mɑ bɑ ɡerumɔ ben ɡɔ̃ruɔ bɑ mɔ̀, su bu nɔni sɔ̃ kɑ dɑm.
Mɑ bɑ bɛsɛn sɑ̃ɑ yenu kpuro dɔ̃ɔ mɛni tem mɛ sɔɔ.
Yinni, sɑ ǹ mɑɑ yĩreru ɡɑru wɑɑmɔ
te tɑ sun sɔ̃ɔsimɔ mɑ ɑ wɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ.
Wunɛn sɔmɔbu bɑ ǹ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Bɛsɛn ɡoo kun mɑɑ yɛ̃ sere sɑɑ yerɑ̀ kɑɑ n sun deri mɛ.
Sere sɑɑ yerɑ̀ kɑɑ n mɑrɑ
yibɛrɛ u n nun nɔɔ kuurimɔ.
Sere sɑɑ yerɑ̀ kɑɑ n nɔɔ mɑɑri
yibɛrɛ u n wunɛn yĩsiru kɑm mɛɛrɑ.
Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ wunɛn nɔmu kuruɑ.
A ɡu dɛmiɔ kpɑ ɑ bu kɑm koosiɑ.
Gusunɔ, sɑɑ yellun di wunɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn sunɔ.
Wunɑ ɑ sun fɑɑbɑ kuɑ nɔn dɑbinu.
Wunɑ ɑ nim wɔ̃ku burɑnɑ kɑ wunɛn dɑm
mɑ ɑ yɛɛ ɡɔbi wiru kɔsukɑ.
Wunɑ ɑ kɑrɑku wiru kɔrɑ,
mɑ ɑ derɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi ɡɑ̃ɑnu ku rɑ kpi bɑ ɡu temɑ.
A derɑ bwiɑ kɑ dɑɑrɑ yɑrɑ,
mɑ ɑ dɑɑnu ɡberɑsiɑ ni nu ku rɑ nim kpe.
Wunɑ ɑ wɔ̃kuru kɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ kuɑ.
Wunɑ ɑ yɑm bururɑm kɑ sɔ̃ɔ kuɑ.
Mɑ ɑ tem nɔɔ burɑ yenu kuɑ.
Mɑ ɑ yɑm susuru kɑ purɑn sɑɑbɑ yi.
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ yɑɑyo mɑ yibɛrɛ u nun yɛ̃ɛmɔ.
Bwese te tɑ ǹ bwisi mɔ, tɑ wunɛn yĩsiru ɡɛmɑ.
A ku wunɛn tɔn be ɑ kĩ mi ɡbeeku yɛɛ deriɑ.
A ku bu duɑri be, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ wɔnwɔndobu.
A wunɛn ɑrukɑwɑni yɑɑyo.
Domi dɑm diobu bɑ yibɑ bɑ kukuɑ mi bɑ ǹ bu wɑsi tem mɛ sɔɔ.
A ku de wi bɑ dɑm dɔre u sekuru wɑ.
A de wɔnwɔndo kɑ sɑ̃ɑro bu nun siɑrɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ seewo ɑ kɑ tii yinɑ.
A yɑɑyo wɔmɑ ye ɡɑri bɑkɑsu rɑ n nun mɔ̀.
A ku wunɛn yibɛrɛbɑn wɔkinu duɑri.
A be bɑ nun seesimɔ bɑɑdommɑn wɔkinu nɔɔwɔ.
